description: Use this when the user wants to sign a PDF, fill in a signature line, find where to sign, or add initials or a date to a PDF form or contract. It reads the PDF's text positions and lists each place labelled Signature, Sign here, Signed, Initials, Date or Name, each blank ____ line, and each empty signature form field, with page, x, y (points from the top-left as displayed), width and a spot id for sign_pdf. Makes no file. Up to 15 MB; the first 50 pages are searched. Does not read scanned PDFs without a text layer (then give page and position to sign_pdf). Do not use for reading or summarizing a contract.

file.description: The PDF to look in, e.g. contract.pdf.

download_url.description: Temporary download link for the file, supplied by ChatGPT.

file_name.description: Original file name if known, e.g. statement.pdf.

mime_type.description: Media type if known, e.g. application/pdf.
